goal: Decide whether LexLean MCP admits a draft an LLM submits, so no path escapes the source roots and no draft exceeds the owner-set limits before LexLean sees it.

app.name: lexlean-mcp-draft-admission
app.title: Draft admission
app.purpose: Decide whether a draft is admitted or which refusal it gets, in the order admitDraft decides: the first path refusal among its rows, too many files, too many content bytes, then a duplicate path.
limits: It does not read the rows: the path field is the refusal of the first row whose path admitPath refuses, or clean.
The limits are the owner values draft.max_files 256 and draft.max_bytes 8388608 of OWNER-VALUES.md.

fields.name: path
fields.means: the first row's path refusal in admitPath's order: UTF-8, NFC, relative, no empty, . or .. component, under a source root, .lex.tex suffix; clean when every row passes

fields.name: bytes
fields.means: content bytes of all rows, not counting path bytes

fields.name: repeats
fields.means: paths that occur more than once among the rows, compared as octets

meanings.path-refused: Verdict.Refused with the row's path refusal, NotUtf8 to NotLexTex

rules.why: src/Admission.lex.tex admitPath: a path that is not UTF-8 is NotUtf8
Admission.admitPath: a path not in NFC under Unicode 17.0.0 is NotNfc, decided by src/Nfc.lex.tex
Admission.admitPath: an absolute path is AbsolutePath
Admission.classifyBits: an empty component is EmptyComponent
Admission.rootsStage: a path under no source root is OutsideRoots
Admission.hasSuffix: a path without the .lex.tex suffix is NotLexTex
Admission.filesStage: more rows than draft.max_files (OwnerValues.draftMaxFiles 256) is TooManyFiles
Admission.bytesStage: more content bytes than draft.max_bytes (OwnerValues.draftMaxBytes 8388608) is TooManyBytes
Admission.admitDraft: the duplicate scan runs last, on a draft the limits admit, and a repeated path is DuplicatePath

app.otherwiseWhy: Admission.admitDraft: every row's path is admitted, the draft is within both limits and no path repeats

properties.why: Admission.admittedPathHasNoDotDot: an admitted path has no .. component
risk R5 (path escape): no path outside the source roots is admitted
Admission: an admitted draft never has more rows than max_files
Admission: an admitted draft never has more content bytes than max_bytes
the duplicate scan runs only on a draft the limits admit

stakeholders.name: LLM client
stakeholders.text: Submits drafts of LexLean modules through the MCP tools and needs each refusal to name what to fix.

stakeholders.name: Server owner
stakeholders.text: Runs LexLean MCP on loopback and needs no draft to escape the source roots or exceed the owner-set limits.

concerns.name: No path escapes the roots
concerns.text: No admitted draft has an absolute path, a .. component or a path outside the source roots.

components.name: LexLean MCP gateway
components.text: The gateway that serves the LexLean tools over MCP and admits a draft before the engine reads it.

components.name: LexLean engine
components.text: LexLean v0.4.0, which checks, snapshots, formats and builds an admitted draft.

components.name: Draft store
components.text: The store of lexlean-mcp/store/1, which keeps drafts for store.draft_retention.

threats.name: Path escape
threats.text: A draft row names ../ or an absolute path to write or read outside the source roots (risk R5).

control.name: Path admission
control.text: Absolute paths, .. components and paths outside the roots are refused, proved for every request.

threats.name: Oversized draft
threats.text: A draft with very many rows or bytes exhausts the engine or the store.

control.name: Owner-set limits
control.text: More than 256 rows or 8388608 content bytes is refused before the engine sees the draft.

threats.name: Look-alike path
threats.text: Two paths that look the same but differ in Unicode normalization name two files a reviewer reads as one.

control.name: NFC required
control.text: A path not in NFC under Unicode 17.0.0 is refused, so equal-looking paths compare as equal octets.

threats.name: Symbolic link escape
threats.text: A row's path is clean but resolves through a symbolic link outside the roots once materialized.
threats.accepted: The symlink clause of control K5 is pending until materialization (issue 9) builds it; path admission is pure and sees no file system.

quality.text: No request whose path is absolute, has a .. component or is outside the roots is admitted.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors answered admitted with path absolute, dotdot-component or outside-roots.

quality.text: Each vector answers the verdict admitDraftRun gives.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors whose replayed verdict differs from the expected one.
